name: Topic Knowledge Snapshot
description: Create or refresh a source-attributed Canvas briefing from active-mode Memory, Intel, and prior conversations. Run only for an explicit personal stored-knowledge snapshot request. Scope: internal artifacts only, with no external research or remember-based synthesis storage.

variables.knowledge_source_counts: No stored Memory or Intel matches were found.

steps.description: Search active-mode Memory and Intel with keyword and semantic retrieval
Search prior terminal and Web conversation history explicitly
Find Intel files whose filenames directly resemble the topic
Read up to five filename-matched Intel files for full-file provenance
Find the durable Canvas page for this topic
Create the topic's durable knowledge snapshot Canvas page
Refresh the topic's durable knowledge snapshot Canvas page

success_speech: Knowledge snapshot complete for ${knowledge_topic}. I retrieved ${knowledge_result_count} Memory or Intel candidates and ${conversation_count} matching prior conversations, then refreshed the topic's Canvas briefing without running new research or calling remember.
abort_speech: Knowledge snapshot failed. Provide a topic after /knowledge and retry; no new research was performed.
